marketing_description: The DeWALT DCN930B framing nailer is a 20 V tool powered by a MAX XR Lithium-Ion battery, featuring a brushless motor for extended runtime and durability. It accommodates 30 ga strip nails ranging from 2 to 3-1/2 in at a 30 deg magazine angle with selectable bump and sequential actuation types. Additional features include tool-free depth adjustment, a dry-fire lockout, and a stall release lever to reset the driver blade.
